regime_context: The detector shows a wide, multi-themed regime (no one-narrative dominance; absorption only 0.31) with US Energy Complex as the co-leader alongside Memory/HBM. Energy is eligible and trend-durable, but 12 of the top 14 ranked themes are crowded, so this is a mature, broad defensive/value-tilt tape with no validated diffusion edge — the only validated leg is the absolute-trend gate, which is active and helped historically. No strong directional claim is supported; leans are low-conviction conditionals.
emerging_watch: Watch whether equal-weight energy (us_sector_energy, durability 0.72) sustains breadth above ~0.8 while cap-weighted US Energy Complex (crowded z 1.03, mixed) fails to make new highs — that would mark a confirmed leadership handoff toward the less-crowded equal-weight structure. Retire the watch if XLE breadth drops below 0.7 for two consecutive weeks.

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Among the eligible, durable, trend-healthy themes, equal-weight energy looks the cleanest long: eligible=true, durability_bar 0.72 (highest of the top-ranked), hurst_tag trend, and crowded=false (crowding_z 0.47). This is the trend-gate leg, not a momentum call — the validated edge is staying in durable trends, and this is the least crowded way to express the energy leadership.
theses.dissent: US Energy Complex (the cap-weighted sibling, rank 2) is crowded (z 1.03) and has hurst_tag mixed, meaning the leadership itself is contested; equal-weight could simply lag if the energy tape consolidates.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 20-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Non-AI Tech & Hardware
theses.thesis: Non-AI tech is eligible, trend-tagged, and one of the few uncrowded themes in a crowded tape (crowded=false, z 0.52). Breadth is low (0.385), which argues the move is narrow/leader-driven, but the trend-gate leg favors holding eligible trends that are not reflexively extended. This is a de-crowded-tape qualifier, not an alpha claim.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.385 means this is a handful of names carrying the theme, not a broad sector move — a single earnings miss can undo the trend; Technology EW (a cleaner broad proxy) has the same XLK proxy but much weaker breadth context.

falsifier.text: XLK gives up its relative gain vs SPY and closes below SPY total return over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The score leader (rank 1) is ineligible (eligible=false) with durability_bar 0.30 — well below the trend-gate threshold — and breadth 0.0, meaning the headline strength is not confirmed by participation. Hurst tag says trend but with zero breadth this is a single-name carry, not a theme. The only honest lean is avoid, strictly on the trend-gate absence.
theses.dissent: Semis leadership can persist on a narrow leadership base for weeks; hurst_tag trend and rank 1 suggest the move is not rolling over yet.

falsifier.text: SMH closes above its 20-day average and remains there for 5 consecutive days before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
